# ArgumentFamily with the arguments of "!quote add "Best stream ever" | Alice":
# add, Best stream ever, |, Alice.

# all arguments and their number
$allargs
$argcount arguments: $arg1text, $arg2text, $arg4text
# ranges n to m, both included; a range beyond the last argument ends there
$arg2:3text / $arg1:99text / $arg2:2text
# the longest prefix, the rest of the token stays (B2)
$arg1texts $arg1:2textual
# B4: arguments that do not exist; B6: invalid numbers
$arg5text $arg5:6text $arg0text $arg2:1text $arg1:text $argtext
# delimited arguments, split at "|" with white space removed
$argdelimitedcount parts: [$argdelimited1text] [$argdelimited2text] [$argdelimited3text]
$argdelimited0text
